quiz.title: Discover India
quiz.description: Sample quiz — geography, history and culture of India.

blocks.md: Quick questions about *Bhārat* — from the Himalayas to the backwaters of Kerala.

items.prompt: What is the capital of India?
items.answerExplanation: New Delhi, part of the vast Delhi metropolis, is the seat of India’s government.

items.prompt: The Bengal tiger is India’s national animal.
items.answerExplanation: India is home to most of the world’s wild tigers.

items.prompt: How tall is the Qutb Minar, in metres? Closest answer wins.
items.answerExplanation: Begun around 1200 in Delhi, the red-sandstone tower rises about 73 m.

items.prompt: Which of these monuments is the Taj Mahal?
items.answerExplanation: Emperor Shah Jahan built it in Agra in the 17th century, in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

options.alt: A white basilica with domes on top of a hill, behind trees
A white columned building with a large dome, in the morning light
A grey stone dome with a golden cross on top, above a ring of columns
A white marble mausoleum with a great dome and four minarets, beside a river

items.prompt: Which of these are Indian dishes?
items.answerExplanation: Paella is a rice dish from Valencia, in Spain.

items.prompt: Which sacred river flows past the ghats of Varanasi?
items.answerExplanation: Pilgrims bathe in the Ganges — the Ganga — from Varanasi’s riverside steps.

blocks.md: In the Himalayan foothills, *Darjeeling* gives its name to one of the world’s most famous teas.

items.prompt: Which desert lies in north-western India?
items.answerExplanation: The Thar, or Great Indian Desert, covers a large part of Rajasthan.

items.prompt: Order these Indian cities from north to south.
Which Indian city is the home of Bollywood?
items.answerExplanation: The name blends Bombay, Mumbai’s former name, with Hollywood.

items.prompt: The Ganges flows into the Arabian Sea.
items.answerExplanation: The Ganges ends in the Bay of Bengal, through a vast delta.
